items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: his son turned out to be one of the finest jazz players in the world, Gene Ammons.

ctx.x: And naturally in the process I heard Albert talk about this son of his who he expected to be a great jazz tenor player, and I didn't even know where he was, I hadn't heard of him before. And then I looked up several years later and I found out what he was talking about, because his son turned out to be one of the finest jazz players in the world, Gene Ammons.
